newsitem.title: USA: USANA says sees net up, no reason for drop.
newsitem.headline: USANA says sees net up, no reason for drop.

text.p: USANA Inc said Thursday it does not know why the price of its common stock has recently been sinking.
It said it expects earnings to improve in the second quarter and through the remainder of fiscal year 1997.
The company stock has been steadily declining from a high of 29-1/4 hit in August. On Wednesday the stock went from 12-1/4 to 9-1/4.
USANA said the improvements will come because of increased revenues and better operational efficiency.
The company on April 17 reported earings per share of $0.18 for the first quarter of 1997, which is the same amount it reported for the same period a year ago.
The company reported operating income of 1.886 million versus 1.797 million for the same period a year ago.
